import 'dart:async';

Future<void> defer(void Function() work) async {
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  scheduleMicrotask(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future.microtask(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future<void>.microtask(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future.delayed(Duration.zero, work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 0), work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 16), work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero, work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Timer.run(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Timer(Duration.zero, work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 5), work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  Future<void>(work);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-dart
  await null;
  Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 17), work);
  Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1), work);
  Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 250), work);
  Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) => work());
  final value = Future.value(1);
  await Future.wait([value]);
}
